laws.rule: Upper Mustang restricted area (Lomanthang, Lo-Ghekar Damodarkunda, Baragung Muktichetra ward 3 and Satang): Nepal Tourism Board currently lists USD 50 per person per day (about A$71 at the RBA rate of A$1 = USD 0.704 on 30 October 2026). A previously cited Immigration page listed USD 500 for the first ten days, then USD 50 a day. The two published descriptions differ on the minimum charge: confirm the total for the intended dates with the Department of Immigration or a registered trekking agency before paying.
laws.heading: Restricted area permit fees

laws.rule: Manaslu restricted area (Chumnubri rural municipality wards 1 to 4): September to November USD 100 per person for the first week (about A$142) then USD 15 a day (about A$21.31); December to August USD 75 for the first week (about A$107) then USD 10 a day (about A$14.20).
laws.heading: Restricted area permit fees

laws.rule: Restricted area permits are issued only to groups of two or more trekkers arranged through a registered trekking agency, are paid in Nepali rupees at the equivalent rate, and cannot run past the visa expiry date.

layers.authority: Nepal Department of Immigration; Nepal Tourism Board
layers.process: The Nepal Tourism Board lists a restricted-area trekking permit for Tsum Valley, including Chumnubri rural municipality wards 3, 6 and 7. Its published charge is USD 40 per person for a week from September to November (about A$57), or USD 30 from December to August (about A$43), plus USD 7 per additional day (about A$10). AUD estimates use A$1 = USD 0.704, Reserve Bank of Australia, 30 October 2026. Check the route, current charge and any separate protected-area entry requirements with Immigration or a registered agency.

layers.authority: Nepal Department of Immigration; Nepal Tourism Board
layers.process: The Nepal Tourism Board lists a restricted-area trekking permit for Narpa wards 1 to 5 and Nasho wards 6 and 7 in Manang. It lists USD 100 per person per week from September to November (about A$142) or USD 75 from December to August (about A$107), then USD 15 per additional day (about A$21) in either season. AUD estimates use A$1 = USD 0.704, Reserve Bank of Australia, 30 October 2026. Confirm which part of the route is covered and whether other park permissions apply.
